standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the assertion to the affine case by gluing over unions.

standard_prerequisites.name: On an affine scheme the derived category of quasi-coherent modules is equivalent to the derived category of modules, and perfect objects correspond to bounded complexes of finite projective modules
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the module representation of E and the translation of alpha.

standard_prerequisites.name: The stupid truncation distinguished triangle of a bounded complex exhibiting the last term
standard_prerequisites.use: Supports the induction on the length of P^bullet reducing to a single term.

standard_prerequisites.name: Elements of a module supported on V(f) are annihilated by a power of f, and a map from a finite module into a module whose elements are f-power torsion is annihilated by a single power of f
standard_prerequisites.use: Concludes the annihilation in the single-term case.

core_obligations: Glue: by Mayer-Vietoris for Hom, if the annihilation holds for f|_U, f|_V and f|_{U cap V} on U, V with X = U cup V, it holds for f on X; the induction principle then reduces to X affine (proof lines 3657-3662).
Affine setup: with X = Spec(A), use the affine comparison to work in D(A), represent E by a bounded complex of finite projective modules P^bullet via the perfect-affine lemma (proof lines 3665-3670).

Reduce P^bullet to a single term: the stupid truncation triangle with the last term P^t[-t] gives an induction on the length of P^bullet, and the shift functor removes the degree, leaving P a finite projective module in degree 0 with alpha a map P -> H^0(M^bullet) (proof lines 3671-3679).
Conclude: H^0(M^bullet) is supported on V(f) so its elements are f-power torsion; since P is finite, finitely many exponents suffice and f^n alpha = 0 for some n (proof lines 3680-3685).
proof_roadmap: Glue the assertion over opens and reduce to X affine (proof lines 3657-3662).
Represent E by a bounded complex of finite projective modules (proof lines 3665-3670).
Induct on the length down to a single finite projective module in degree 0 (proof lines 3671-3679).
Conclude by f-power torsion of the supported target module (proof lines 3680-3685).
